# Refund handling instructions

1. Always confirm the customer's order number before starting a refund.
2. Respond to every refund request within one business day.
3. Restate the customer's stated problem in your first reply, before any policy text.
4. Refunds up to 50 currency units may be approved without manager sign-off.
5. All refunds require manager sign-off before processing.
6. Log the outcome (approved, denied, or escalated) in the case record.
